name: My Happy Family
source:
My Happy Family... Is an VN that centers around an MC who had just returned from a month long vacation away from his family only to find that the dynamic of his family suddenly changes. Without warning he returns home to find that his mother had gotten herself a new boyfriend her first "real" boyfriend since her separation with their father. In the short time that he's been gone the boyfriend had moved in.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
《我的幸福家庭》是一部以一位MC为中心的VN，他刚从家人那里度过了一个月的长假回来，却发现家人的动态突然发生了变化。在没有任何警告的情况下，他回到家，发现他的母亲给自己找了一个新男朋友，这是她与父亲分居后的第一个“真正的”男朋友。他离开没多久，男朋友就搬进来了。

[来自F95Zone]
